sources.snippet: STM32 model zoo v4.0 (online) Free AI models optimized for STM32 The STM32 AI model zoo is the largest collection of pre-trained AI models (140+) optimized to run on STM32 microcontrollers. Available on GitHub, it is a valuable resource for anyone looking to add AI capabilities to their STM32-based projects.
